name_reason: Compliant with game-function convention fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: fd2_ prefix present, descriptor accurately states the action (mark char-occupant tiles for a team). No Ghidra address residue in the name. Reflects the verified body (writes 0xFF into battle_tile_map overlay byte +7 for alive chars of the selected team).
purpose: Mark battle-tile overlay byte +7 = 0xFF at the position of every alive character matching team_selector (skipping exclude_idx), so movement/pathfinding scans treat those tiles as impassable (occupied).
logic_summary: Stack-check __CHK(0x10), then iterate i=0..data_fd2_battle_party_member_count-1 over runtime_char records (stride RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE=0x50) starting at data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr. Skip i==exclude_idx and chars with CHARFLAG_DEAD (pChar[5]&1). Team gate: if team_selector==0 act only when pChar[6]==TEAM_ENEMY (==0); else (team_selector!=0) act only when pChar[6]!=TEAM_ENEMY. When gate passes, set *(battle_tile_map_ptr + ((pChar[1]*map_width_tiles + pChar[0]) * 4) + 7) = 0xFF, where pChar[0]=bPos_x, pChar[1]=bPos_y. No return value.

params.name: exclude_idx
params.semantics: Index of the acting character to skip while marking (caster_idx / char_idx passed by all three callers). Used as i != exclude_idx so the actor's own tile is not marked occupied.
params.reason: Name precisely reflects use (the excluded character index) and carries no address residue.

params.name: team_selector
params.semantics: Team polarity selector. 0 -> mark chars with bTeam==0 (TEAM_ENEMY); non-zero -> mark chars with bTeam!=0. Callers pass the battle context flag (ctx/ctx_flag) or literal 1.
params.reason: Name accurately describes the parameter's role (selects which team's chars are marked) and has no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is in-place writes to the battle_tile_map +7 overlay bytes.

notes: Polarity note: TEAM_ENEMY is defined as 0 in src/include/consts.h, so 'team_selector==0 marks team 0' equals 'marks pChar[6]==TEAM_ENEMY'. Source comment (btl_aitg.c lines 97-103) uses neutral 'team 0 / team !=0' phrasing which is correct and clearer than tying it to TEAM_ENEMY; left unchanged. Constants verified: RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE=0x50, CHARFLAG_DEAD=0x01, TEAM_ENEMY=0. global writes_globals empty: the function writes into the buffer pointed to by data_fd2_battle_tile_map_ptr (heap/overlay memory), not into a named global variable itself. No source edits (comment kept, no rename in this stage); plate consistent with refined understanding.
